owner: Reports48 lease ended; explicit new Reports owner required
consumer: 60 only on explicit authorized resumption, or authorized successor
lease_boundary: Mission66 does not own product/reviews/**. Only inert receipt files were written; neither the renderer nor Reports48 tests/helpers were edited.

evidence_basis.observation: Current renderer prints the preserved review ID/version/time and opaque BusinessEvidenceRef.refId strings in value tables. It does not print ordinary captured SourceRef version/incarnation or general DomainProjection.engineVersion.
evidence_basis.observation_status: SOURCE_READING; current66 hosted file evidence is tracked separately and does not validate this proposal.

criteria.text: Pauta, tela de reunião, comparação e arquivo deixam claros período, referência, seleção e condição de comparabilidade.
criteria.relationship: Legible captured reference and period; the criterion does not prescribe these exact labels, font or layout.

criteria.text: Interfaces são concretas, versões/digests são verificáveis e falhas possuem causa e estado explícitos.
criteria.relationship: Verifiable capture versions; opaque refIds currently require a separate retained manifest to interpret the source version.

evidence_basis.user_requirement: Qualify generated file content, sources and versions. This proposal makes already captured source stamps directly readable; it does not invent a new format or weaken any requirement.

changes: Append a Captured source line per source of each selected section using the existing paginated section text path for both DOCX and PPTX.
Include surface, type, ID, source version, incarnation and the captured source period.
Include captured engineVersion only when it is a nonempty string already present in the selected DomainProjection.
Change the renderer intent version to wp07-paginated-v3-source-provenance because the rendered content changes.
patch.semantics: Use only the already authorized preserved capture. No current source lookup, recalculation, authority expansion, schema change or new UI is proposed.
patch.renderer_intent_effect: Existing artifact bytes remain downloadable through the existing read path. Regeneration under a pre-upgrade command key would compare a different renderDigest and fail as an intent conflict;48/60 must assess this existing compatibility behavior before adoption.

validation.preimage_byte_identity: COMPLETE; local artifact hashing only, no product execution
validation.applicability: Must be rechecked by48 against its live head and exact preimage; never apply across an unknown owner delta.

stop_before_apply.reason: Additional provenance lines can create extra pages/slides. The existing pagination is reused, but actual layout, long source IDs and clipping have not been rendered. The proposal must stop before application until48/60 reviews and qualifies those effects.
owner_checks: Reconcile exact live owner blob and CAS; retain the current Reports48 changes if the preimage has advanced.
Exercise DOCX and PPTX with real generated files and parse every selected source stamp plus the captured engine version.
Change current source versions after preservation; exported stamps must remain those of the chosen review.
Render the long-note/25-record cases and long source IDs using the assigned hosted renderer; inspect completeness, clipping and pagination.
Verify unselected/private source details and authority metadata remain absent.
Verify original-command behavior across the renderer intent version change and document the chosen compatibility policy.
Run the relevant surgical hosted Actions and the assigned compiler/guard interface before any acceptance claim.
